scope: Contract and bounded proposal/execution regression with synthetic image and actuator fixtures; not a live model or complete pick/place test.
checks: Omitted narrative passes provider/core proposal without motion; only next execution actuates once
Missing narrative never bypasses tool allowlist, numeric bounds, required arguments or two-correction limit
Navigation, onboarding and mission validators preserve absence/presence and legacy description compatibility
Report counts each accepted model decision once and excludes offline decisions/result duplicates
